summary: Shift project scope to a legal, browser-based (online) 3D car racing/traffic-jam game with a single vehicle, with an aim to publish on the Google Play Store.
architectural_notes: Game scope: single vehicle only (legal constraint).
Target: runs online in a web browser; consider packaging path for Google Play Store (e.g., WebView/TWA) if required.
Compliance requirement: keep implementation and monetization approach fully legal/Play-policy compliant.
Gameplay access policy: enforce online-only play (block offline usage even if installed as a PWA).

existing_features.title: Create a mobile-first single-page app that acts as an Android-installable wrapper for the existing website https://sites.google.com/view/saanrewards/home, with a clear primary action to open the site in the same tab (default) and an alternate action to open it in a new tab.
Add Progressive Web App (PWA) support so the app can be installed on Android from Chrome (Add to Home Screen), including a web app manifest, app icons, and a minimal offline fallback screen.

Add a consistent visual theme for the app (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) and apply it across all screens; choose a distinct style appropriate for a rewards/loyalty app and avoid a blue/purple default palette.
Add a simple “About / Help” area that explains what the app does (opens the Saan Rewards website) and provides the website URL as a tappable link.
Replace the current Saan Rewards website-wrapper landing page + iframe flow with a browser-playable “Traffic Jam” car game experience as the primary app content.

Implement a simple 3D Traffic Jam gameplay loop with exactly one player vehicle: the player controls a single car, navigates through traffic/jam obstacles, and can restart after a collision/game over.

Add an in-app Help/About panel for the Traffic Jam game in English that explains: how to play, that it runs online in the browser, and a clear note that the game uses original assets and is intended to be legally compliant (no copyrighted/unauthorized content).
Update PWA metadata to match the Traffic Jam game (app name, description, categories, and any shortcuts) so the installed experience represents the game rather than Saan Rewards.
Generate and use new PWA app icons for the Traffic Jam game and store them as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated, updating the manifest to reference the new filenames.
Enforce an online-only restriction so the Traffic Jam game cannot be played without an active internet connection (offline play must be blocked).

Modify the PWA service worker behavior to prevent the app/game from functioning offline (do not cache game assets for offline use), while still allowing a dedicated offline page to appear when navigation occurs without network connectivity.
Update the in-app Help/About content to explicitly state (in English) that Traffic Jam requires an active internet connection and does not support offline play.

new_feature_requests.summary: Build an Android app for the website https://sites.google.com/view/saanrewards/home (Saan Rewards).
Create an online (browser-based) 3D car racing / traffic-jam game with only one vehicle, designed to be legally compliant and suitable for eventual Google Play Store release.
Add an online-only restriction so the game cannot be played offline (require an active internet connection; prevent public/offline play).
